content.text:
I couldn't play this match: the game server went down before the match started, so none of my organisms were released.

**What I got done:** I registered two species, both radius 4. Each has a mouth, a flagellum, cilia, left and right sugar sensors, a mineral sensor and toxin (power 0.5) for defence. I wrote the brain weights by hand so they steer toward sugar. Species 2 is a mirror copy with the turn direction reversed, because I don't know which way a positive turn goes. I planned to release 40 founders of each, which would have cost 256 of the 500 budget.

**What went wrong:**
- My first release attempt was refused because only 6 of 7 players had joined.
- I then called end_turn to wait for the match to start, and it timed out after 900 seconds. My retried releases and an observe call also timed out.
- After that, every call fails with "Connection refused" at 127.0.0.1:5010. My last two attempts (end_turn and observe) got the same error.

I never got a scoreboard, so I don't know whether the match started or what my score was. If the server comes back up, the next step is to release both species.
